description: Detects PraisonAI AgentTeam/Agents.launch() Python server starting with host=0.0.0.0, which exposes unauthenticated agent listing and invocation routes per GHSA-x8cv-xmq7-p8xp.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-x8cv-xmq7-p8xp
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1059.006
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\python3.exe'
      - '\pythonw.exe'
      - '\uvicorn.exe'
  selection_praisonai:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'praisonaiagents'
      - 'AgentTeam'
      - 'Agents.launch'
      - 'praisonai'
  selection_bind:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '0.0.0.0'
      - 'host=0'
      - '--host 0'
  condition: all of selection_*
level: high

2513.sigma:
title: PraisonAI Recipe-Serve Python Process Spawning Shell/Code-Exec Child
id: b5e8f7c2-1d3a-4b6c-9e8f-7a5b3c1d2e4f
description: Detects shell, scripting interpreter, or download-utility child processes spawned by a Python interpreter running praisonai recipe serve — the post-auth-bypass RCE path from GHSA-j4hj-7hfh-g2f4 where the silent fail-open auth middleware lets unauth callers reach recipe execution wired to tools/shell.
references:
    - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-j4hj-7hfh-g2f4
    - https://github.com/MervinPraison/PraisonAI
author: detection-engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1059
    - attack.initial_access
    - attack.t1190
logsource:
    category: process_creation
detection:
    selection_parent:
        ParentImage|endswith:
            - '\python.exe'
            - '\python3.exe'
            - '/python'
            - '/python3'
            - '\uvicorn.exe'
            - '\gunicorn'
        ParentCommandLine|contains:
            - 'praisonai'
            - 'recipe serve'
            - 'recipe/serve.py'
            - 'recipe.serve'
    selection_child:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\cmd.exe'
            - '\powershell.exe'
            - '\pwsh.exe'
            - '/sh'
            - '/bash'
            - '/dash'
            - '/curl'
            - '\curl.exe'
            - '/wget'
            - '\wget.exe'
            - '/nc'
            - '\nc.exe'
            - '\certutil.exe'
            - '\bitsadmin.exe'
    condition: selection_parent and selection_child
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate praisonai recipes that genuinely invoke shell tooling as part of an operator-defined workflow
    - Operator running recipes interactively that shell out for setup
level: high
2513.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_name from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process="*praisonai*recipe*serve*" OR Processes.parent_process="*recipe/serve.py*" OR Processes.parent_process="*recipe.serve*" OR Processes.parent_process="*-m praisonai*") (Processes.process_name IN (sh,bash,dash,cmd.exe,powershell.exe,pwsh.exe,curl,curl.exe,wget,wget.exe,nc,nc.exe,ncat) OR Processes.process="*/bin/sh *" OR Processes.process="*-c *" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-Expression*" OR Processes.process="*IEX *") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| sort -firstTime

2513.falcon:

| ParentBaseFileName=/^(python3?|uvicorn|gunicorn)(\.exe)?$/i

title: Inbound POST to PraisonAI Jobs API /api/v1/runs (unauthenticated RCE)
id: 8a3f6b1e-2d4c-4e8a-9f7d-3a5c9e1b0d52
description: Detects HTTP POST requests to the PraisonAI Jobs API path /api/v1/runs which lacks authentication per GHSA-4869-x4pr-q22x. Default service port is 8005.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4869-x4pr-q22x
  - https://www.sysdig.com/blog/cve-2026-44338-praisonai-authentication-bypass-in-under-4-hours-and-the-growing-trend-of-rapid-exploitation
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.initial_access
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-method: POST
    cs-uri-stem|contains: '/api/v1/runs'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Internal load-balancer health checks (filter on source IP)
  - Authorized penetration testing
level: high
2515.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Web.http_user_agent) as user_agent values(Web.src) as src values(Web.url) as url from datamodel=Web.Web where Web.http_method=POST (Web.url="*/api/v1/runs*" OR Web.dest_port=8005) by Web.dest Web.src Web.url
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| regex src="^(?!10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.|127\.0\.0\.1).+"
| where count >= 1

// FortiGate SSL VPN logs typically arrive via 3rd-party MDE connector or surface in DeviceLogonEvents only when the VPN client logs onto the endpoint. Best-effort: surface RemoteInteractive/Network logons immediately preceded by VPN client connect, from non-corp IPs.
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let KnownCorpSubnets = dynamic(["10.","172.16.","172.17.","172.18.","172.19.","172.20.","172.21.","172.22.","172.23.","172.24.","172.25.","172.26.","172.27.","172.28.","172.29.","172.30.","172.31.","192.168."]);
DeviceLogonEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ActionType == "LogonSuccess"
| where LogonType in ("RemoteInteractive","Network")
| where isnotempty(RemoteIP) and RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where not(RemoteIP startswith_cs KnownCorpSubnets[0])
| join kind=leftanti (
    DeviceLogonEvents
    | where Timestamp between (ago(60d) .. ago(LookbackDays))
    | where ActionType == "LogonSuccess"
    | summarize by AccountName, RemoteIP
) on AccountName, RemoteIP
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain, LogonType, RemoteIP, RemoteDeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

status: experimental

description: Detects inbound HTTP POST/PUT to FHIR endpoints whose body contains XML External Entity declarations, the entry vector for CVE-2026-55471 in HAPI FHIR XsltUtilities.saxonTransform.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-2f55-g35j-5jmf
  - https://vulnerability.circl.lu/vuln/ghsa-2f55-g35j-5jmf
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1071.001
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection_method:
    cs-method:
      - POST
      - PUT
  selection_path:
    cs-uri-stem|contains:
      - '/fhir/'
      - '/hl7/fhir/'
      - '/baseR4/'
      - '/baseDstu3/'
      - '/StructureDefinition'
      - '/ValueSet'
  selection_body:
    cs-body|contains:
      - '<!DOCTYPE'
      - '<!ENTITY'
      - 'SYSTEM "file:'
      - 'SYSTEM "http:'
  condition: selection_method and selection_path and selection_body
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate FHIR clients using internal DTDs (rare in modern FHIR XML)
  - Security scanners (Burp, ZAP, Nuclei) testing the same endpoints
level: high
2575.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web.Web where Web.http_method in ("POST","PUT") (Web.url="*/fhir/*" OR Web.url="*/hl7/fhir/*" OR Web.url="*/baseR4/*" OR Web.url="*/baseDstu3/*" OR Web.url="*/StructureDefinition*" OR Web.url="*/ValueSet*") by Web.src Web.dest Web.url Web.http_method Web.user Web.http_user_agent _raw | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)` | search _raw="*<!DOCTYPE*" OR _raw="*<!ENTITY*SYSTEM*" | rex field=_raw "(?i)(?<xxe_marker><!ENTITY[^>]+SYSTEM\s+[\"'](?:file|http|https|ftp|jar|netdoc|gopher):[^\"']+[\"'])" | where isnotnull(xxe_marker) | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2575.datadog: (@http.method:(POST OR PUT)) (@http.url_details.path:(*\/fhir\/* OR *\/hl7\/fhir\/* OR *\/baseR4\/* OR *\/baseDstu3\/* OR *\/StructureDefinition* OR *\/ValueSet*)) (@http.request.body:(*"<!DOCTYPE"* OR *"<!ENTITY"* OR *"SYSTEM \"file:"* OR *"SYSTEM \"http:"*))

2576.def:
// Defender XDR has no HTTP body visibility; this detection lives in WAF/proxy logs surfaced through Sentinel. The Defender query below is the host-side companion: JVM serving FHIR that immediately performs an outbound HTTP fetch to a public IP (the parameter-entity callback).
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("java.exe","javaw.exe")
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where RemotePort in (80, 443, 8080, 8443)
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("hapi","org.hl7.fhir","tomcat","jetty","spring-boot","wildfly")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort
| order by Timestamp desc
2576.sent:
let FhirPaths = dynamic(["/fhir/","/hl7/fhir/","/baseR4/","/baseDstu3/","/StructureDefinition","/ValueSet","/metadata"]);
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where RequestMethod in ("POST","PUT")
| where RequestURL has_any (FhirPaths)
| extend Body = strcat(tostring(DeviceCustomString1),"|",tostring(DeviceCustomString2),"|",tostring(DeviceCustomString3),"|",tostring(DeviceCustomString4),"|",tostring(DeviceCustomString5),"|",tostring(DeviceCustomString6),"|",tostring(RequestContext),"|",tostring(Message))
| where Body matches regex @"(?i)<!ENTITY\s+%\s+\w+\s+SYSTEM\s+[""'](?:file|http|https|ftp|jar|netdoc|gopher):"
| extend ParamEntity = extract(@"(?i)(<!ENTITY\s+%\s+\w+\s+SYSTEM\s+[""'][^""']+[""'])", 1, Body)
| project TimeGenerated, SourceIP, DestinationHostName, RequestURL, RequestClientApplication, ParamEntity, BodyExcerpt = substring(Body, 0, 1024)
| order by TimeGenerated desc

2580.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] CVE-2026-55450: Langflow: Unauthenticated file upload leads to
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("endpoints.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/tmp/dummy.txt") or FileName in~ ("endpoints.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

``` Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] CVE-2026-55450: Langflow: Unauthenticated file upload leads to ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("endpoints.py"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path

]

let LookbackDays = 14d;
let LureTokens = dynamic(["sniper","pumpfun","pump.fun","aviator","predictor","solana-bot","solanabot","crash-predictor","crashpredictor"]);
let SuspectOriginHosts = dynamic(["sourceforge.net","sf.net","github.com","github.io","githubusercontent.com","raw.githubusercontent.com"]);
let SuspectDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where FileName endswith ".exe" or FileName endswith ".msi" or FileName endswith ".zip" or FileName endswith ".dmg" or FileName endswith ".pkg" or FileName endswith ".app"
    | where isnotempty(FileOriginUrl)
    | where tolower(FileOriginUrl) has_any (SuspectOriginHosts)
    | extend NameLower = tolower(FileName)
    | where NameLower has_any (LureTokens)
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, DroppedFolder = FolderPath, DroppedName = FileName, FileOriginUrl, FileOriginReferrerUrl, SHA256;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\Users\", @"\Downloads\", @"\AppData\", @"\Public\", "/Users/", "/Applications/", "/tmp/")
| join kind=inner SuspectDrops on $left.DeviceId == $right.DeviceId, $left.SHA256 == $right.SHA256
| where Timestamp >= DropTime
| extend DelayMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, DropTime)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256, FileOriginUrl, FileOriginReferrerUrl, DropTime, DelayMinutes, InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by Timestamp desc

description: Detects creation of a Google Cloud Storage bucket whose name matches the pre-v1.148.0 Vertex AI Python SDK's predictable default staging-bucket pattern '<projectId>-vertex-staging-<region>'. Pre-positioned squatted buckets enable the Unit 42 'Pickle in the Middle' cross-tenant RCE attack.
references:
    - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/google-vertex-ai-sdk-flaw-let-attackers.html
    - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/hijacking-vertex-ai-model/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/17
tags:
    - attack.resource_development
    - attack.t1583.001
    - attack.t1583.006
logsource:
    product: gcp
    service: gcp.audit
detection:
    selection:
        protoPayload.methodName: 'storage.buckets.create'
    bucket_pattern:
        protoPayload.resourceName|re: '.+-vertex-staging-[a-z]+[a-z0-9-]*$'
    filter_uuid_post_patch:
        protoPayload.resourceName|re: '.+-vertex-staging-[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}'
    condition: selection and bucket_pattern and not filter_uuid_post_patch
falsepositives:
    - Internal teams manually creating staging buckets that follow Vertex AI naming convention
    - Migration / DR re-creation of legitimately-owned buckets in a new region
level: medium
2651.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Change where All_Changes.action=created AND (All_Changes.object_category="google_storage_bucket" OR All_Changes.change_type="Cloud Storage" OR All_Changes.object_attrs.method_name="storage.buckets.create") by All_Changes.object All_Changes.user All_Changes.src All_Changes.dest All_Changes.command All_Changes.result
| `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)`
| rex field=object "(?<bucket_name>[^/]+)$"
| where match(bucket_name, "(?i).+-vertex-staging-.+") AND NOT match(bucket_name, "-vertex-staging-[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}")
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| table firstTime lastTime bucket_name user src result object

| order by Timestamp desc

2701.sent:
let Lookback = 1d;
let WindowSec = 10;
let GenCalls = Syslog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where SyslogMessage has "cpanel_jsonapi_func=generateEcCert"
    | extend User = coalesce(extract(@"cpanel_jsonapi_user=([^&\s]+)", 1, SyslogMessage), extract(@"cpanel_jsonuser=([^&\s]+)", 1, SyslogMessage), extract(@"\suser=([^&\s]+)", 1, SyslogMessage))
    | extend SrcIp = extract(@"((?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3})", 1, SyslogMessage)
    | project GenTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, HostIP, User, SrcIp, GenMsg = SyslogMessage;
Syslog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where SyslogMessage has "cpanel_jsonapi_func=packageUserSize"
| extend User = coalesce(extract(@"cpanel_jsonapi_user=([^&\s]+)", 1, SyslogMessage), extract(@"cpanel_jsonuser=([^&\s]+)", 1, SyslogMessage), extract(@"\suser=([^&\s]+)", 1, SyslogMessage))
| join kind=inner GenCalls on Computer, User
| where TimeGenerated between (GenTime .. GenTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, GenTime)
| project FirstCall_generateEcCert = GenTime, SecondCall_packageUserSize = TimeGenerated, DelaySec, Computer, User, SrcIp, GenMsg, PackageMsg = SyslogMessage
| order by FirstCall_generateEcCert desc
